if(tann){
        predictant_current <- predictant_tann
    }else{
        predictant_current <- predictant_pann
    }
       

    # correlation parts

        # not the same age range: fits for long cores
        # correlations; neglect human impact for pollen correlation
        posterior_temp$post_pollen <- cor(predictant_current[ages_pollen][hi_ages_time], predictors1[hi_ages_time],na.rm=TRUE)
        if(posterior_temp$post_pollen < 0 | is.na(posterior_temp$post_pollen)) posterior_temp$post_pollen <- 1e-10
        posterior_temp$post_iso <- cor( predictant_tann[ages_iso],predictors2,na.rm=TRUE )
        if(posterior_temp$post_iso < 0 | is.na(posterior_temp$post_iso)) posterior_temp$post_iso <- 1e-10

        posterior_temp$post_pollen <- posterior_temp$post_pollen^2
        posterior_temp$post_iso <- posterior_temp$post_iso^2

        # try to minimize human impact
        if(hi_time){

            posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- cor( predictant_pann[ages_pollen][!hi_ages_time],-df_speleo$iso[!hi_ages_time],na.rm=TRUE )
#             print( posterior_temp$post_iso_hi)
            if(posterior_temp$post_iso_hi < 0 | is.na(posterior_temp$post_iso_hi)) posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- 1e-10
            posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- posterior_temp$post_iso_hi^2
        }else{
            posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- 0.95
        }

    }else{
        # iso or pollen correlation
        if(sources[,4] == 1){
            posterior_temp$post_iso <- cor(predictant_tann[ages_iso1],predictors$iso_time[ages_iso2],na.rm=TRUE)
            if( posterior_temp$post_iso < 0 | is.na(posterior_temp$post_iso)) posterior_temp$post_iso <- 1e-10  
            posterior_temp$post_iso <- posterior_temp$post_iso^2
            posterior_temp$post_pollen <- 0.5
            
        }else{
            posterior_temp$post_pollen <- cor(predictant_current[ages_pollen1][hi_ages_time],predictors$pollen[ages_pollen2][hi_ages_time],na.rm=TRUE)
            if( posterior_temp$post_pollen < 0 | is.na(posterior_temp$post_pollen)) posterior_temp$post_pollen <- 1e-10  
            posterior_temp$post_pollen <- posterior_temp$post_pollen^2
            posterior_temp$post_iso <- 0.5
#             posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- 0.95
        }
        
        # try to minimize human impact
        if(hi_time){
#             posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- cor( predictant_tann[ages_iso1][!hi_ages_time],predictors$iso_time[ages_iso2][!hi_ages_time],na.rm=TRUE )
            posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- cor( predictant_pann[ages_pollen1][!hi_ages_time],-df_speleo$iso[!hi_ages_time],na.rm=TRUE )
#             posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- cor( predictant_pann[ages_pollen][!hi_ages_time],ird_data$proxy_data[common_age_ird][!hi_ages_time],na.rm=TRUE )
#             print( posterior_temp$post_iso_hi)
            if(posterior_temp$post_iso_hi < 0 | is.na(posterior_temp$post_iso_hi)) posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- 1e-10
            posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- posterior_temp$post_iso_hi^2
        }else{
            posterior_temp$post_iso_hi <- 0.95
        }
        
    }
